shots.prompt: 3D animated cartoon, Pixar style. The two Roman guards march the muscular gladiator a few steps forward toward the camera across the arena sand and stop. The gladiator then stands still waiting nervously, swallowing, eyes darting up toward the emperor's box. The cheering crowd waves in the stands. Static camera, warm sunlight.

3D animated cartoon, Pixar style. The muscular gladiator's shoulders slump and he hangs his head sadly. The two Roman guards turn him around and slowly lead him away, walking toward the back of the arena. The crowd in the stands waves. Static camera, warm sunlight.

3D animated cartoon, Pixar style. The two Roman guards march the short stocky mustached gladiator a few steps forward toward the camera and stop. He stands waiting nervously, clutching his shield, glancing up toward the emperor's box and twitching his mustache. The cheering crowd waves in the stands. Static camera, warm sunlight.

3D animated cartoon, Pixar style. The short stocky gladiator droops his head sadly and his shield drops lower. The two Roman guards turn him around and slowly lead him away toward the back of the arena. The crowd in the stands waves. Static camera, warm sunlight.

3D animated cartoon, Pixar style. The two Roman guards march the lanky red-haired gladiator with the net and trident a few steps forward toward the camera and stop. He stands waiting with a nervous grin, shifting from foot to foot, glancing up toward the emperor's box. The cheering crowd waves in the stands. Static camera, warm sunlight.

3D animated cartoon, Pixar style. The lanky red-haired gladiator's grin fades, he lowers his trident and hangs his head sadly. The two Roman guards turn him around and slowly lead him away toward the back of the arena, dragging his net. The crowd in the stands waves. Static camera, warm sunlight.

3D animated cartoon, Pixar style. The chubby emperor on the golden throne frowns sternly, raises his right arm forward with a closed fist and firmly turns his thumb down, holding it there. The crowd behind him reacts. Static camera.

kokoro.text: There is no Buffalo Wild Wings anywhere in Canada. Not one. There is no Texas Roadhouse. There are only two or three Outback Steakhouses in the whole of Canada, all of them in Niagara Falls. So why does America's closest neighbour, a country that already loves burgers, wings and hockey on TV, keep spitting out America's favourite restaurants? The chains came. Some came twice. And one by one, they packed up, shrank, or never showed up at all.
